import json, os, urllib.error, urllib.request
GW = "https://mott-booking-gw.mail.mybcat.com"
auth = os.environ["GW_TOKEN"].strip()
if not auth.lower().startswith("bearer"):
    auth = "Bearer " + auth
for phrase in ("thursday", "the following thursday", "following thursday", "thursday next week"):
    body = {"store": "711", "from": phrase, "to": phrase, "slot_minutes": "15", "after": "none", "before": "none", "time_pref": "none"}
    req = urllib.request.Request(GW + "/availability", data=json.dumps(body).encode(), method="POST", headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli", "Authorization": auth})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
            payload = json.loads(r.read().decode() or "{}")
        res = (payload.get("result") or {})
        slots = res.get("slots") or []
        starts = sorted({str(s.get("start", ""))[:10] for s in slots if s.get("start")})
        print("DEPLOYED_RESOLVE(%s)=count=%s dates=%s" % (phrase, res.get("count"), ",".join(starts) if starts else "none"))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print("DEPLOYED_RESOLVE(%s)=HTTP_%s %s" % (phrase, e.code, e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:120]))
    except Exception as e:
        print("DEPLOYED_RESOLVE(%s)=ERROR %s" % (phrase, type(e).__name__))
print("PROBE_DONE")
PY
rc=$?; cat probe.txt; exit $rc
